documents.err_schedule_fields_removed.en: Celerp no longer keeps {fields}: an agreement bills from its start date, and its periods name the documents it billed.

documents.err_schedule_fields_owned.en: Only an agreement's own schedule actions can set {fields}.

subscriptions.err_agreement_status_elsew.en: An agreement that bills or sends on its own changes status only on its own page: activate, pause, resume or cancel it there.

subscriptions.send_again_confirm.en: Sending was cut off, so this email may already have arrived. Send it again anyway?

subscriptions.doc_period_rebilled.en: That period was reopened on the agreement and is now billed on {newer}, so this document no longer bills it.

subscriptions.doc_period_reopened.en: That period was reopened on the agreement, so this document no longer bills it. Use Generate due on the agreement to bill the period.

subscriptions.history_send_settled.en: The bill for {start} to {end} was sent from its own page.
